reviewNotes: The issuer lists no annual fee and unlimited 1.5% cash back. Purchase-derived, uncapped rewards are excluded by the recurring-benefit rules, so this card intentionally has no tracked benefits. Global synchronization disposition: create card:city-national-cash-back; there are no benefit definitions or existing-card statuses to propagate, and no Benefit Usage Guide linkage is needed. The issuer-hosted image was downloaded from the product page and is recorded in docs/card-image-sources.md.
